artboards.title: HTS applications - what happens to the reads

annotations.text:
IN THE DECK as slide "HTS applications - what happens to the reads" (w1b_omics-data.qmd), exported to img/hts-applications.png at 2x.

One visual grammar: the reads are the SAME neutral grey everywhere - in the pile and in all three panels - so the only thing that changes between panels is what each analysis pulls out of them (blue contig, amber mismatches, teal gene bins).

Set in Source Sans Pro, the face the reveal.js slides use, embedded here so it matches and needs no network. Sized for projection: headings land near 24px against 30px body text at 95% slide width. If you edit the type, re-export at 1400x734.
